[[File:CoolWatch.jpg|150px|thumb|A BX-series droid commando uses a remote viewer to avoid giving away his position.]]
A '''remote viewer''' was a small self-contained audio/video sensor attached to a micro [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]. It was mounted on a droid and would perform as a regular sensor, but could be detached and sent to scout an area remotely. It normally could be deployed for 30 minutes before needing to be recharged. Remote Viewers were frequently used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
